items.title: Macmillan lends support to UK prostate cancer data project
items.summary: Prostate Progress, a data-powered project to find better tests, treatments and care for prostate cancer, is expanding through an alliance with Macmillan.

items.title: AstraZeneca Imfinzi gains FDA expansion in muscle-invasive bladder cancer
items.summary: The FDA has approved AstraZeneca’s Imfinzi with Padcev for cisplatin-ineligible muscle-invasive bladder cancer, based on the Volga study.

items.title: Coloplast launches 'Funding the journey' programme to free up about DKK 500 million
items.summary: Coloplast's 2025/26 full-year results on 03/11/2026 set out a 'Funding the journey' programme to free up about DKK 500 million, with about 75% of the impact in 2026/27 and full impact in 2027/28, and about DKK 200 million of related special items.
